name: Isomorphic Labs
tagline: AI-first drug design built on AlphaFold for pharma R&D.
description: Isomorphic Labs is an AI-first drug discovery company spun out of Google DeepMind, building generative and predictive ML models for molecular design and drug-performance prediction. Its Drug Design Engine builds on AlphaFold to advance internal and partnered pipelines with Eli Lilly, Novartis, and J&J. It is a drug-discovery company that works through pharma R&D partnerships rather than a self-serve product.
insight: DeepMind spinout (2021); raised a $600M Series A led by Thrive Capital with Alphabet and GV in March 2025 — its first external capital.
edge: Direct lineage to Nobel-winning AlphaFold plus Alphabet backing — few AI-drug shops pair that model pedigree with deep-pocket pharma partnerships.
